title: Finite module supported only at a maximal ideal has finite length
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $M$ be a finite nonzero $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] whose support [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] is contained in $\{\mathfrak m\}$. Then $M$ has finite length over $R$; equivalently, $\mathrm{length}_R(M)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length] is a positive natural number.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00L5 (algebra-lemma-support-point: a nonzero finite module over a Noetherian local ring with support {m} has finite length)

proof.text: Let J be the annihilator of M. For each prime p of R/J, its inverse image in R contains J, so belongs to Supp(M) by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-module-support-annihilator]. The support hypothesis identifies this inverse image with the maximal ideal. Since the quotient map is integral, p is maximal as well. Ring.krullDimLE_zero_iff therefore gives Krull dimension at most zero for R/J.

proof.text: The quotient R/J is Noetherian by Mathlib Ideal.Quotient.isNoetherianRing. Mathlib IsNoetherianRing.isArtinianRing_of_krullDimLE_zero applied to its Krull-dimension bound gives IsArtinianRing (R ⧸ J).

source.place: Tag 00L5, lemma-support-point; alternate annihilator quotient argument using Tag 00KH and Tag 00JB

proof.text: Use Mathlib Module.quotientAnnihilator for the canonical R/J-action on M. The existing finite generating set over R also generates over R/J by Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite. Mathlib isArtinian_of_fg_of_artinian' gives IsArtinian (R/J) M. The bijective semilinear identity along the surjective quotient map, via LinearMap.isArtinian_iff_of_bijective, gives IsArtinian R M.

proof.text: M is Noetherian because R is Noetherian and M is finite. Module.length_ne_top now makes its length finite and Module.length_pos makes it positive. Take the natural number given by ENat.toNat, using ENat.natCast_toNat and ENat.toNat_pos.
